memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Irritable bowel syndrome: Status: symptomatic, reports abdominal bloating and diarrhoea 2-3 days/week. Plan: Continue mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD, loperamide 2 mg SOS; review stool routine and tTG-IgA.
- Osteoarthritis knee: Status: mild pain on stairs, VAS 3/10. Plan: Continue paracetamol 650 mg SOS, topical diclofenac gel BD, calcium‑vit D3 OD; arrange weight‑bearing X‑ray both knees and serum vitamin D.
- Migraine: Status: 2 episodes/month, responsive to sumatriptan. Plan: Continue propranolol 40 mg OD, topiramate 25 mg HS, naproxen 500 mg SOS; arrange neurological exam and CT head.
- Weight: 78 kg; Waist: 92 cm (male cut‑off 90 cm) – advise reduced carbohydrate intake.
- Due: HbA1c not applicable (no glucose‑lowering therapy).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Mebeverine 135 mg – 1‑0‑1 – after food
Ispaghula husk 5 g – 1‑0‑0 – with water
Loperamide 2 mg – 0‑0‑1 – after food SOS
Paracetamol 650 mg – 0‑0‑1 – after food SOS
Topical diclofenac gel – apply BD to knees
Calcium carbonate 500 mg + Vitamin D3 400 IU – 1‑0‑0 – after food
Propranolol 40 mg – 1‑0‑0 – after food
Topiramate 25 mg – 0‑0‑1 – at bedtime
Naproxen 500 mg – 0‑0‑1 – after food SOS
Sumatriptan 50 mg – 0‑0‑1 – at onset SOS

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
CBC: Hb 13.8 g/dL (13‑17), WBC 6.2×10⁹/L (4‑10), Plt 210×10⁹/L (150‑400).
Stool routine: No ova, cysts, or pus cells; pH 6.0.
tTG‑IgA: 4 U/mL (<7 negative).

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Weight‑bearing X‑ray both knees: Mild joint space narrowing medial compartment, no significant osteophytes. Impression: Early osteoarthritic changes, bilateral symmetric.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum 25‑OH Vitamin D: 22 ng/mL (30‑100 sufficient). Insufficient.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Neurological examination: No focal deficits, normal gait, mild pericranial tenderness. No migraine‑related abnormal signs.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: CT head (plain): No acute hemorrhage, infarct, or mass lesion. Normal study.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Via clinic app: 'Doctor, my bloating has worsened after eating wheat bread; I have loose stools twice today. Knee pain is okay. Migraine stayed at two episodes this month.'

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Referral to Dr Sumanth Rao, Gastroenterology, St. Martha’s Hospital. Reason: Persistent IBS‑type symptoms, need to rule out microscopic colitis and consider dietitian review.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Gastroenterology report: Colonoscopy normal, biopsies show no microscopic colitis. Patient advised low‑FODMAP trial; continue mebeverine. No further action needed.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Irritable bowel syndrome: Status: Improved on low‑FODMAP, bloating down 1‑2 days/week. Plan: Continue mebeverine, ispaghula, loperamide SOS; repeat tTG‑IgA if symptoms worsen.
- Osteoarthritis knee: Status: Pain VAS 2/10 after paracetamol SOS. Plan: Continue current regimen; add calcium‑vit D3 OD if not already; repeat vitamin D in 3 months.
- Migraine: Status: 1 episode/month, sumatriptan effective. Plan: Continue propranolol, topiramate 25 mg HS; consider increase topiramate to 50 mg HS if breakthrough.
- Weight: 77 kg; Waist: 90 cm (at cut‑off).
- Due: HbA1c not applicable.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Topiramate increase to 50 mg – 0‑0‑1 – at bedtime
All other medications unchanged.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Lipid profile: Total cholesterol 190 mg/dL (<200 desirable), LDL 110 mg/dL (<130), HDL 45 mg/dL (>40), Triglycerides 130 mg/dL (<150).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Irritable bowel syndrome: Status: Well controlled, no diarrhoea for 3 weeks. Plan: Continue current meds; consider tapering loperamide SOS.
- Osteoarthritis knee: Status: Mild discomfort after prolonged standing, VAS 2/10. Plan: Continue paracetamol SOS, topical diclofenac, calcium‑vit D3; repeat X‑ray in 12 months.
- Migraine: Status: Free of episodes for 6 weeks on topiramate 50 mg HS. Plan: Maintain prophylactic dose.
- Weight: 76 kg; Waist: 88 cm (below male cut‑off).
- Due: HbA1c not applicable.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for 2026-01-12 09:30 with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04) for routine follow‑up. Patient confirmed via SMS.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Irritable bowel syndrome: Status: Symptom‑free, occasional bloating after festive meals. Plan: Continue mebeverine BD, ispaghula husk OD; loperamide stopped.
- Osteoarthritis knee: Status: Stiffness morning, improves with movement; VAS 2/10. Plan: Continue paracetamol SOS, topical diclofenac, calcium‑vit D3 OD; check vitamin D level.
- Migraine: Status: No headaches for 3 months. Plan: Continue propranolol 40 mg OD, topiramate 50 mg HS.
- Weight: 75 kg; Waist: 86 cm.
- Due: HbA1c not applicable.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Calcium carbonate 500 mg + Vitamin D3 400 IU – 1‑0‑0 – after food (continued)
All other medications unchanged.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Irritable bowel syndrome: Status: Remains asymptomatic. Plan: Continue mebeverine BD, ispaghula husk OD; PRN loperamide only if needed.
- Osteoarthritis knee: Status: Mild aching after long walks, VAS 2/10. Plan: Continue current regimen; repeat serum vitamin D.
- Migraine: Status: No headaches, topiramate 50 mg HS well tolerated. Plan: Continue prophylactic therapy.
- Weight: 74 kg; Waist: 84 cm.
- Due: HbA1c not applicable.
